any return, exit, target-hit, outcome, capacity, portfolio, NAV, validation, challenge, or post-2021 row/result

hypothesis: The old pipeline permanently consumed a gap after its first prior-high reversal even when that bar failed a contemporaneous investability gate. Keeping the gap armed until the first bar that simultaneously shows a fresh below-L snapback, valid liquidity state, two-sided price discovery, and orderly demand can recover economically identical opportunities without adding an outcome-conditioned feature.

parent_reproduction_policy.retention_assertion: Every old V28R2 gap whose old signal itself satisfies the uniform new CY033 raw-tick, action-free, lineage-complete final gate must remain selected. Old coordinate floating-point artifacts and cross-action coordinates are not grandfathered.

signal_rule.action_coordinate_rule: The gap row, every post-gap row through the candidate, and every row in the candidate trailing-20 window must be action-free: corporate_action_count=0, corporate_action_blocking=false, share_multiplier=1, cash_per_share=0. Unknown fails closed.
signal_rule.candidate_window: completed CY033 daily bars with gap_age 10 through 14 inclusive, stopping at the first L touch, invalid lineage, or post-gap corporate-action coordinate barrier
signal_rule.first_only: Select the first final-quality bar per frozen V13 gap_id; at most one signal per gap.

raw_price_tick_semantics.low20_tie: Use the most recent occurrence of the minimum raw cent tick in the trailing 20 rows.
raw_price_tick_semantics.no_L_touch: post-gap high tick must remain strictly below frozen raw L tick
raw_price_tick_semantics.prior_high_reversal: current close tick > previous high tick

required_composite.V13: max post-gap depth below L >=10%; candidate remains >=5% below L; days since most-recent 20-row low tick 1..10; recovery from that raw low >=3%; prior-high raw-tick reversal
required_composite.V28: signal state valid and non-ST; exactly 20 prior daily rows have complete lineage; at most one prior one-price limit-down row
required_composite.V28R1: signal raw close < registered up-limit price - 0.006 CNY
required_composite.V28R2: positive signal amount <=2.0 times the median positive amount of the 20 completed trading sessions strictly before the signal; unknown intervening trade_status or incomplete lineage fails closed

signal_rule.signal_timestamp: completed daily decision_at; every consumed available_at and decision_at must be no later than the candidate decision_at

subsequent_execution_stage.fixed_direction_if_separately_preregiste: Use registered CY-008 execution_5m window_index=0 only, require trade_date>signal_date and record available_at after the signal; describe its price as the next-day 09:31-09:35 first-window open, never as a 1-minute fill. Do not use entry-day 15:00 CY033 state as a 09:31 selection feature. Preserve pending corporate-action known<=signal and effective>=entry blocking semantics.
